data.entranceFeeDescription: A valid entrance fee or park pass is required to enter Rocky Mountain National Park, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. This includes, but is not exclusive to, outer locations like Lumpy Ridge, Lily Lake, Longs Peak, Wild Basin, East Inlet, and North Inlet. Entrance passes are non-transferable and non-refundable.

data.timedEntryHeading: Visiting between now and October 20? You might need a Timed Entry.
data.timedEntryDescription: Planning to visit Rocky Mountain National Park? Depending on where you would like to visit and what time of day you plan to arrive, you might need a timed entry. To visit destinations on Bear Lake Road from 5 a.m. to 6 p.m., you will need a Timed Entry + Bear Lake Road reservation through Oct 20, 2024.

fees.paymentDescription: Park entrance passes may be purchased in person at any of the park's entrance stations or online at www.recreation.gov. Entrance passes are non-transferable and non-refundable.
fees.description: 1-Day Vehicle Entrance Pass. This pass is valid for one private vehicle to enter RMNP for one day only. All passengers inside the vehicle are covered. Each non-US resident aged 16 and older visiting Rocky Mountain National Park must pay a $100 nonresident fee (in addition to the standard entrance fee), unless admitted with an Annual or America the Beautiful Pass. This includes nonresidents entering as part of a commercial tour group, commercial use authorization (CUA) group, or concessioner tour group.

passes.description: RMNP Park-specific Annual Pass. This park pass is valid for entry to RMNP only for 1 year. One pass is good for one passholder and may be used in any personal vehicle. Park entrance passes may be purchased in person at the any of the park's entrance stations or in advance online at www.recreation.gov.
